corrections: Translated and reread Strings/Locations source ordinals 320–355 directly from English, covering Birdie’s repeated closing branch, the Walnut Room door, boat repairs, ostrich hatching, Professor Snail’s field-office finale and the first twenty-two parrot nut hints.

Applied locked Golden Walnut, Battery, Hardwood, Iridium Bar, Professor Snail, Ostrich Incubator, Barn and volcano terminology while preserving every event command, identifier, quantity, coordinate, timing, branch marker, placeholder and layout space.
Matched Birdie’s corrected neutral blessing exactly, translated every quoted finale speech and its recipe notification, and kept the parrot hints terse, elliptical and deliberately indirect.
